description: Review and improve English copy using SlopMonster-inspired pattern checks, factual safeguards, and audience-focused editing guidance.

defaultPrompt: Review this draft for common AI-writing patterns and improve it for its intended reader. Preserve all supported facts and flag claims that need evidence.
Humanize this copy without inventing facts, personal opinions, testimonials, numbers, or experiences.
Audit this README, email, landing page, or script for clarity, repetition, voice, and unsupported claims, then rewrite it.
interface.longDescription: Apply a SlopMonster-inspired review workflow to English drafts: inspect common AI-writing patterns, revise for audience and purpose, preserve claims and technical meaning, and recheck the finished copy. This conversational plugin does not run the repository's Python checker or invoke a second model automatically.

name: slopmonster-writing-review
